Subject: Spike in 5xx & throughput drop impacting nightly jobs

Ava,

We observed a sustained throughput drop starting ~00:30 UTC last night that caused our nightly batch scoring jobs to miss SLAs. Error rate spiked (5xx) and retries compounded cost. This hit three production jobs and caused downstream delays for our data pipeline.

Can you confirm root cause and whether you will provide remediation credits per the contract? We need an exec-level contact; our CPO (cc'd Ethan) is asking for a commercial restoration plan and timeline.

Attached: incident_log_20260920.txt (text/plain)

Thanks,
Cara

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Cara Nguyen <cara.nguyen@cumuluslabs.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Spike in 5xx & throughput drop impacting nightly jobs

Ava / team — preliminary findings:
- Timeline: increased queuing at the inference gateway between 00:27–01:10 UTC; peak queue depth ~4x baseline.
- Root cause: an atypical traffic fan-out from one of Cumulus’s high-concurrency pipelines interacted poorly with a newly-enabled batching heuristic on our side; the heuristic increased batching window by up to 120ms under that shape, which amplified tail latency and triggered cascade retries.
- Impact: transient 5xx rate elevated to ~3.6% for the window; overall token throughput dropped ~28% during peak.

Immediate mitigations applied (00:45 UTC): rolled back batching heuristic for Cumulus routing, increased worker concurrency on dedicated pool, and enabled targeted KV cache warming for frequently requested prefixes. Error rate fell back to baseline by ~01:18 UTC.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Formal post-incident analysis (ops-runbook draft) — deliverable by 2026-09-22 11:00 PDT.
2) Proposed commercial remedy: credit equal to 10% of September bill for usages tied to the affected routes, with a reconciliation workbook (attached).
3) Config lock: pin the batching profile for Cumulus until we complete a controlled A/B test in staging.

Attaching: throughput_analysis_q3.pdf, proposed_credit_calc.xlsx

Ben Carter
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Cara Nguyen <cara.nguyen@cumuluslabs.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Spike in 5xx & throughput drop impacting nightly jobs

Adding low-level context for contract/legal/finance:
- We confirmed no customer data exposure and all logs indicate internal queue/backpressure behavior.
- Repro steps: synthetic replay in staging recreates queue amplification when the specific fan-out pattern is present + heuristic enabled.
- Repair scope & ETA: code rollback already deployed for Cumulus routing (complete). We will run a safety A/B test this week (target: Wed 09/23) before enabling any adjusted batching improvements.

It’s safe to propose a commercial credit; recommended conservative amount: prorated credit for affected interval plus a 5% goodwill uplift to restore trust. See proposed_credit_calc.xlsx.

Dev Patel
SRE, Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Cara Nguyen <cara.nguyen@cumuluslabs.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Exec-level proposal: remediation & contract pathway

Cara / Ethan — looping in org leadership briefly with a proposal we can sign off on today so you have a clear commercial path forward. High level:
1) Credit proposal (final): 12% credit on September usage attributable to routes X/Y/Z, applied as account credit to be used over the next 6 billing cycles. This combines the measured impact and a 5% goodwill uplift.
2) Contract amendment: we will add a targeted guardrail that pins the batching profile for affected routes and requires staged rollout/testing for any batching heuristic changes. Draft amendment link below.
3) Operational commitments: dedicated weekly health report for the next 8 weeks, one quarterly joint postmortem within 30 days, and a playbook run with your SREs for handling spikes.
4) Approval & signature: we can apply the credit upon internal approval and a countersigned amendment (DocuSign). If you prefer immediate account credit without amendment, we can do that pending follow-on paperwork.

Please confirm whether the 12% credit and 6-month consumption window works for Cumulus. If yes, I’ll route to finance and legal today and send the DocuSign.

Marissa Cole
VP, Sales & Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: proposed_credit_calc.xlsx

Marissa — thanks for the clear proposal and the fast turnaround. Cumulus accepts the 12% credit applied as account credit over 6 cycles. We also want the batching-profile guardrail in the contract amendment; please send DocuSign and the draft amendment for our legal review.

Operational asks: please confirm the schedule for the weekly health reports (proposed first report: 2026-09-29) and include the playbook run dates. We’ll coordinate our SRE availability.

Appreciate the responsiveness — this addresses our immediate commercial ask and gets us moving on preventing recurrence.

Cara Nguyen
